mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and subsequently driving up the S&P 500 index over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, and ultimately resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a low unemployment rate and a high payroll employment level indicates a strong labor market, which drives up consumer spending and subsequently leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market conditions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates a decrease in supply, leading to higher prices and subsequently driving up the S&P 500 index over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a high level of housing starts and a strong GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and subsequently driving up the S&P 500 index over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong demand conditions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index indicates inflationary pressures, leading to decreased purchasing power and subsequently resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a low unemployment rate and a high level of retail sales indicates a strong labor market and high consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market conditions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales indicates decreased consumer spending, leading to lower demand and subsequently resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining retail sales (t-test p > 0.05).
